sn44.3:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sārīputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
sn44.3:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā sārīputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sārīputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn44.3:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ etadavoca
sn44.3:2.1: kiṃ nu kho āvuso sārīputta hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.3:2.4: kiṃ panāvuso na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.3:2.7: kiṃ nu kho āvuso hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.3:2.9: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.3:2.10: kiṃ panāvuso neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.3:2.12: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.3:3.1: kiṃ nu kho āvuso hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno abyākataṃ kho etaṃ āvuso bhagavatā
sn44.3:3.3: kiṃ panāvuso neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.3:3.5: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vadesi.
sn44.3:3.6: ko nu kho āvuso hetu ko paccayo yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
